name: Hivalta Inspired by Nishane Hacivat | Premium Unisex Perfume
description: Hivalta, inspired by the iconic Nishane Hacivat, is a modern unisex fragrance crafted for those who appreciate freshness, elegance, and luxury in every spray. The scent opens with a bright fusion of pineapple, bergamot, and citrus accords, delivering a refreshing and uplifting burst. As it settles, refined jasmine and woody nuances unfold, adding depth and sophistication to the fragrance. Finally, a long-lasting base of oakmoss, patchouli, and amber creates a smooth, powerful finish that lingers beautifully. With its premium oil concentration, Hivalta offers excellent longevity and projection—perfect for daytime wear, office settings, evening events, or signature scent lovers. Bold yet refined, fresh yet woody, Hivalta delivers the premium Hacivat experience at an accessible price, exclusively from Scents by Aamir. Features Top Notes: Pineapple, Bergamot, Citrus Accords Heart Notes: Jasmine, Woody Notes Base Notes: Oakmoss, Patchouli, Amber Longevity: 8–10 hours (Long-Lasting) Occasion: Perfect for office, daytime wear, and evening events Why Choose Hivalta? Inspired by the luxurious Nishane Hacivat Strong, long-lasting projection with premium oil concentration A perfect balance of fresh, fruity, and woody notes Exclusive unisex scent available only at Scents by Aamir
